title: Gmail read-only: MCP path
description: Scripted walkthrough of the MCP setup and test. No Google login or mailbox access occurs in playback.

markers.title: Set up Google OAuth and get the adapter
markers.note: Complete the test-project and Desktop client checklist in your browser. Save the individual adapter files, then create a Python environment.

markers.title: Install the adapter dependencies
markers.note: Run this in the adapter directory. The install log depends on your platform and is omitted here.

markers.title: Check the fixture
markers.note: This is the adapter output from a credential-free run.

markers.title: Authorize the adapter
markers.note: On your machine, store client.json outside the project first. The browser consent and token are not shown or executed here.

markers.title: Check the saved grant
markers.note: Run this yourself after sign-in, then configure the MCP server using only paths.

markers.title: Connect the agent
markers.note: Verify gmail-demo in OpenCode, or use /mcp test gmail-demo in Oh My Pi.

markers.title: Test with a Read-Only Request
markers.note: In the agent, ask it to use only the gmail-demo MCP server and call search_demo once. Review the tool trace; do not open messages.
